title: How Alignment and Jailbreak Work: Explain LLM Safety through Intermediate Hidden States
reasoning: The paper investigates the internal mechanisms of LLM safety by analyzing how models distinguish between 'ethical' and 'unethical' (malicious) inputs. It evaluates the model's internal hidden states to determine if and how it identifies 'ethical concepts' during pre-training and alignment, making ethics/morality categorization central to the research.
